definitions.gloss: right to control; ruling authority; dominion; sovereignty
definitions.explanation: The authority or right to exercise control over a territory, organization, or resource. Used in political, legal, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {支配権|しはいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支配権|しはいけん}をめぐって⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Conflict continued over control of the region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支配権|しはいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{経営陣|けいえいじん}→経営陣：20535_keieijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}った→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: Control of the company was transferred to a new management team.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧ (control, domination) and {権|けん} (right, authority). Refers to the legitimate or de facto authority to exercise control. Often used in discussions of political power, colonial history, corporate governance, and legal disputes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支配権|しはいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to seize control
- {支配権|しはいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose control
- {支配権|しはいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧: control shifts
- {支配権|しはいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めぐる⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: struggle over control

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主権|しゅけん}→主権：18294_shuken⟧: sovereignty — specifically national sovereignty over a state or territory
- ⟦{覇権|はけん}→覇権：14113_haken⟧: hegemony — dominance on a larger scale, often international
- {統治権|とうちけん}: governing authority — focuses on the legal right to govern
